{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Convert batch B values from µg/L to ng/mL (divide by 10)
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Compute the mean
mean_biomarker_final_ngml = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()

# Print result
mean_biomarker_final_ngml"}
